title: Natural native derived tensor model comparisons
statement: For any two functors into native K-flat cochain complexes on a finite-type quasi-compact separated scheme, the native derived tensor of their images in the derived category is naturally isomorphic to the quotient of their native total tensor.

source.place: K-flat tensor representatives and their simultaneous naturality, Tag 06YN

proof.text: Take the natural model isomorphisms of nativeDerivedTensor_models and evaluate them on the two given families. Their simultaneous naturality proves naturality for the uncurried total tensor, so NatIso.ofComponents assembles the desired isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem native_tensor_model_comparison (k₀ : Type u) [Field k₀] [Finite k₀]
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {A : Type v₁} {B : Type v₂} [Category.{w₁} A] [Category.{w₂} B]
    (F : A ⥤ CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
    (G : B ⥤ CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ P, NativeIsKFlat k₀ l X (F.obj P))
    (hG : ∀ T, NativeIsKFlat k₀ l X (G.obj T)) :
    Nonempty ((F ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod (G ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙
        nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l X ≅
      F.prod G ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l X) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
